rounds.text: The valuation leaves virtually zero room for error, with a discounted cash flow model pinning intrinsic value at Rs 223 per share against a market price of Rs 224, resulting in a negative margin of safety of -0.6% [E45, E46]. Furthermore, the company's historical earnings power has been lacklustre, demonstrated by a poor sales growth of 9.72% over the past five years [E60] alongside a low median return on equity of 8% over both 3-year and 5-year periods [E27, E28, E61] and a meager 4% compounded profit growth over 5 years [E19]. Compounding these operational concerns, the stock suffers from severe annualised volatility of 51.3% and a grim historical peak-to-trough drawdown record of -62.1% [E53, E54]. Institutional confidence is also drifting, highlighted by negative money flow signals and a recent holding reduction [E44, E67]. Conceded: the company trades at an EV/EBITDA of 7.6x compared to a sector benchmark of 18.02x [E11].
